decisions.reason: The provisioning wizard's informational purpose, required background and header logo, optional footer, and superseded prior visual details are already represented by its message-56 MODIFY; the landing-page background basis is stated specifically for AWS Cognito authentication pages.
Its existing message-56 MODIFY already records the shared visual foundation for the Sign In and Account Provisioning pages, including the required background and header logo and optional footer.
The existing message-56 MODIFY already records that footer inclusion is optional on both the Sign In page and Account Provisioning wizard, along with the footer's specified content and styling.
The Sign In styling change does not alter legal-document access; the legal links are a separate clause already represented by the candidate's message-56 INTRODUCE.
The informational Sign In page styling does not change the independently scoped console shell design.
Reusing the landing-page background as the basis for an AWS Cognito page does not modify the landing page's own visual system.
The source decision concerns informational access-page styling and does not change the landing page's How It Works section.
Creating and styling a Sign In page does not change the landing-page sign-up button or its action.
The source specifies visual elements for informational pages but introduces no change to responsive landing-page behavior.
The Sign In page styling decision does not alter which content is included on the landing page.
Using an existing landing-page background for Cognito does not modify the requested token sheet, font files, or content-width specification.
The source defines visual content for informational pages but does not establish or revise cross-page responsive rules.
